$comment: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. This exists ONLY so the usable end-to-end path can be exercised. It is not platform output, not configuration, and not evidence of anything. Nothing reads this file outside the end-to-end regression test.
whyThisExists: The production-like sample scenario (scenarios/auth-txn-to-emi.json) deliberately carries NO tenant context, because this prototype has no platform integration. That run is blocked, which is the honest result. Without a second fixture the usable path would have no end-to-end coverage at all, so this supplies the tenant the platform would have supplied.

tenantContext.$issuerNote: A REAL issuer from the application's own PROGRAM_OPTIONS (src/data/sharedConstants.ts), chosen so the proposal is not blocked by an unknown-issuer mapping. Using a real issuer name here does NOT mean the tenant-to-issuer mapping has been verified in production — no production mapping exists, and nothing here establishes one.
tenantContext.$mappingNote: tenantId and issuer are kept SEPARATE and neither is derived from the other. In production the platform asserts this mapping; here the fixture asserts it, which is a test convenience and nothing more.

notVerified: That SYNTH-TENANT-0001 corresponds to IndusInd Bank (IBL), or to any real tenant.
That the platform would supply tenant context in this shape.
That issuer-dependent functionality (Smart Tags and others) resolves correctly for this issuer — the application models no issuer keying for it.
